tpd.t010: Clear FLOOR1 Neoteric Battle Field within 16 minutes.
tpd.t012: The entrance to Secret Floor2 is on FLOOR3. Once you unlock the secrets, shortcut warps appear in the city so you can go straight there.
tpd.t013: The quest board entry for The Phantasmal Dimension.
tpd.t015: Two rules apply inside the boss rooms and they decide how the fight is played.
tpd.t018: Once the team has used 20 revives in total, the boss fires an enrage attack that wipes the party.
tpd.t019: Using a Photon Blast unequips your mag.
tpd.t021: All three are buffed versions. Weaknesses matter here, so bring the right attribute.
tpd.t026: A resist value of 75 or higher makes you immune to the shock and freeze these bosses apply. That is usually worth more than raw defence.
tpd.t028: These attacks ignore defence and always deal the same amount, so they decide the minimum HP you need. Researched by Nyanchi JP.
tpd.t031: Epsilon's Rafoie scales with your fire resist, so resist gear cuts it by more than half.
tpd.t033: Each circle is one wave seen from above, numbered in spawn order. Red arrows mark enemies that come in from outside the ring. Charts by thanx JP.
tpd.t047: Twice per run, after beating Deos Behemoth and Bar Dalus.
tpd.t048: CHAOS HALO has a different guard effect from the other halos, so you can tell it apart in game.
tpd.t050: Suggested loadouts for the secret bosses, from Nyanchi JP. Treat them as a reference point rather than a requirement.
tpd.t054: A boss announces its skill name before it fires. The symbols in the name tell you what shape the attack takes, so learning them is faster than memorising every skill.
tpd.t058: Damage falls off with distance from the centre of the explosion.
tpd.t060: Circular area of effect. Spread out from each other.
tpd.t065: Increases the damage you take from the [X] attribute.
tpd.t067: Your HP must be full when the effect ends.
tpd.t068: Source: the quest channel, plus the TPD Wave thread in the Discord strategy forum. Spawn charts by thanx JP, fixed damage values researched by Nyanchi JP, gear lists by Nyanchi JP.
tpd.t070: Difficulty 10, Ultimate only, and the longest run on the server. This page collects the floor layout, the room rules, every secret boss and the spawn wave charts the community mapped out.
